addition.item: Option for detailed error messages (file and line) in the activity log; off by default.

change.item: Changelog XML containing a DTD or entity declaration is rejected.
The configured site URL is only used for mail links if it is an http(s) address.
Logged errors no longer include file names and line numbers unless the debug option is on.

addition.item: Joomla update server support: the package can now be updated through the Joomla installer.

change.item: Hardening: only http(s) links are accepted from update data, changelog URLs must resolve to public addresses, redirects are validated, downloads are size- and time-limited, changelogs are parsed without XPath, auto-check on open is throttled.

fix.item: The activity log no longer warns about update server packages that are not installed.

addition.item: Check when the component is opened (never sends mail).
Separate options for emails after manual and scheduled checks.
Link to the Joomla extension update page on the dashboard.

change.item: Check result message is green without updates and yellow with updates.
Joomla Core is shown separately on the dashboard and in emails.
Emails list new updates first and all other open updates below.

fix.item: Database writes failed silently, so history and log stayed empty.
